desc:
Plant your slime and watch it grow to a gigantic size! But be careful— the slime can pop at any time, Don’t get too greedy…

⛏️ Buy a slime from the Mines
🍬 Choose a treat to increase its luck
🟢 Place it inside your plot
📈 Watch your slime grow and increase its multiplier
⚡ Collect it before it Pops!

🎮 Available on PC, Mobile, Tablet and Console

👍 Enjoying the game?
Leave a thumbs up and favorite the game to support future updates!
